name: General Medicine
description: Provides first-contact care for common symptoms, long-term health concerns, and referral planning.
when_to_consult: Consult for a new, persistent, or unclear health concern when the right specialty is not obvious.

name: Cardiology
description: Focuses on the heart, circulation, and cardiovascular risk assessment.
when_to_consult: Consult for ongoing chest symptoms, heart-rhythm concerns, uncontrolled blood pressure, or a clinician-directed cardiac review.

name: Dermatology
description: Cares for conditions affecting the skin, hair, nails, and related allergies.
when_to_consult: Consult for a persistent, spreading, painful, or recurrent skin, hair, or nail concern.

name: Endocrinology
description: Focuses on hormones, metabolism, diabetes, thyroid conditions, and bone health.
when_to_consult: Consult for diabetes management, thyroid-related symptoms, unexplained metabolic changes, or hormone concerns.

name: Gastroenterology
description: Cares for the digestive tract, liver, pancreas, and gastrointestinal symptoms.
when_to_consult: Consult for persistent digestive symptoms, recurrent abdominal pain, or a clinician-directed liver or bowel review.

name: Neurology
description: Focuses on the brain, spinal cord, nerves, and neurological symptoms.
when_to_consult: Consult for recurring headaches, seizure-related concerns, unexplained numbness, balance changes, or neurological follow-up.

name: Pulmonology
description: Cares for the lungs, airways, sleep-related breathing, and respiratory conditions.
when_to_consult: Consult for continuing cough, wheezing, breathlessness, or asthma and inhaler management concerns.

name: Nephrology
description: Focuses on kidney function, fluid balance, blood pressure, and renal replacement care.
when_to_consult: Consult for abnormal kidney tests, recurrent swelling, urine changes, or kidney disease follow-up.

name: Rheumatology
description: Cares for autoimmune and inflammatory diseases affecting joints, muscles, and connective tissues.
when_to_consult: Consult for persistent joint swelling, morning stiffness, recurring inflammatory symptoms, or autoimmune-disease monitoring.

name: Hematology
description: Focuses on blood cells, clotting, anemia, and related disorders.
when_to_consult: Consult for persistent unexplained anemia, abnormal blood counts, easy bruising, or clinician-referred blood concerns.

name: Infectious Disease
description: Focuses on infections, prevention, antimicrobial use, and travel-related health risks.
when_to_consult: Consult for recurring, unexplained, or complicated infections, or when referred for infection management.

name: Medical Oncology
description: Coordinates systemic cancer treatment, monitoring, symptom support, and survivorship care.
when_to_consult: Consult after a cancer diagnosis, for treatment planning, or when referred for an oncology opinion.

name: Geriatric Medicine
description: Provides coordinated health care for older adults with multiple or complex needs.
when_to_consult: Consult for falls, memory changes, multiple medication concerns, frailty, or complex older-adult care planning.

name: Allergy and Immunology
description: Assesses allergic reactions, immune-related concerns, and trigger-management options.
when_to_consult: Consult for recurring allergies, hives, suspected food or drug reactions, or clinician-directed immune evaluation.

name: Pediatrics
description: Provides general health care, prevention, growth monitoring, and illness assessment for children and adolescents.
when_to_consult: Consult for a child’s persistent symptoms, growth or development concerns, or routine pediatric care.

name: Neonatology
description: Cares for newborns, especially premature or medically complex infants.
when_to_consult: Consult through a maternity or pediatric team for a newborn health concern, especially after a high-risk birth.

name: Pediatric Cardiology
description: Focuses on heart conditions present in or affecting infants, children, and adolescents.
when_to_consult: Consult when a child is referred for a murmur, congenital heart condition, fainting, or cardiac symptoms.

name: Obstetrics and Gynecology
description: Cares for reproductive health, pregnancy, gynecologic symptoms, and preventive women’s health.
when_to_consult: Consult for menstrual or pelvic symptoms, pregnancy care, contraception questions, or preventive gynecologic visits.

name: Reproductive Medicine
description: Focuses on fertility assessment, assisted reproduction, and preconception planning.
when_to_consult: Consult after difficulty conceiving, for fertility evaluation, or when seeking reproductive planning support.

name: Maternal-Fetal Medicine
description: Provides specialist care for pregnancies with maternal, fetal, or obstetric risk factors.
when_to_consult: Consult when referred for a high-risk pregnancy, complex medical condition in pregnancy, or fetal-monitoring concern.

name: Orthopedics
description: Cares for bones, joints, ligaments, tendons, and musculoskeletal injuries.
when_to_consult: Consult for persistent joint or back pain, injury, fracture follow-up, or reduced movement.

name: Sports Medicine
description: Focuses on activity-related injuries, exercise health, and safe return to sport.
when_to_consult: Consult for a sports or exercise injury, recurrent pain with activity, or return-to-play planning.

name: Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
description: Helps restore function, independence, mobility, and quality of life after illness or injury.
when_to_consult: Consult for lasting mobility, function, or recovery needs after an injury, surgery, or neurological illness.

name: Pain Medicine
description: Provides multidisciplinary assessment and management options for persistent or complex pain.
when_to_consult: Consult for pain lasting beyond expected recovery, pain limiting daily life, or specialist pain-management referral.

name: General Surgery
description: Provides surgical assessment and treatment planning for common abdominal, skin, breast, and soft-tissue conditions.
when_to_consult: Consult when referred for a possible operation, hernia, gallbladder concern, lump, or postoperative care.

name: Cardiothoracic Surgery
description: Provides surgical care for the heart, major chest vessels, lungs, and chest structures.
when_to_consult: Consult after referral for cardiac, aortic, lung, or chest surgery assessment.

name: Neurosurgery
description: Provides surgical assessment for conditions affecting the brain, spine, and nervous system.
when_to_consult: Consult after a neurology or emergency referral for a structural brain, spine, or nerve condition requiring surgical review.

name: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
description: Restores form and function after injury, burns, surgery, or congenital differences.
when_to_consult: Consult for complex wounds, burns, reconstructive needs, or referral after trauma or cancer surgery.

name: Urology
description: Cares for the urinary tract, bladder, kidneys, prostate, and male reproductive system.
when_to_consult: Consult for recurring urinary symptoms, visible blood in urine, stone concerns, prostate symptoms, or urology referral.

name: Ophthalmology
description: Cares for eye health, vision, and conditions affecting the eye and visual pathways.
when_to_consult: Consult for persistent visual change, eye pain, redness, injury, or a scheduled eye health review.

name: Otolaryngology
description: Cares for conditions affecting the ear, nose, throat, voice, and related head and neck structures.
when_to_consult: Consult for lasting ear, nose, throat, sinus, voice, or hearing symptoms.

name: Dentistry
description: Cares for teeth, gums, oral hygiene, bite function, and oral health conditions.
when_to_consult: Consult for tooth or gum pain, swelling, sensitivity, oral injury, or preventive dental care.

name: Psychiatry
description: Provides medical assessment and treatment for mental health conditions and related symptoms.
when_to_consult: Consult for persistent changes in mood, anxiety, sleep, thought patterns, substance use, or clinician-referred mental health care.

name: Clinical Psychology
description: Uses structured psychological assessment and evidence-informed talking therapies.
when_to_consult: Consult for stress, emotional distress, coping difficulties, behavior concerns, or therapy support.

name: Sleep Medicine
description: Assesses and manages sleep disorders that affect rest, breathing, alertness, and daily functioning.
when_to_consult: Consult for persistent insomnia, loud snoring, witnessed breathing pauses, or severe daytime sleepiness.

name: Radiology
description: Uses medical imaging to support diagnosis, monitoring, and image-guided treatment planning.
when_to_consult: Consult through a referring clinician when imaging is needed or an image-guided procedure is planned.

name: Pathology
description: Analyzes blood, tissue, and other samples to support accurate clinical diagnosis.
when_to_consult: Usually accessed through a referring clinician when laboratory tests or biopsy analysis are needed.

name: Emergency Medicine
description: Provides immediate assessment and stabilization for acute illness, injury, and emergency warning signs.
when_to_consult: Seek emergency care now for severe or sudden symptoms, trouble breathing, major bleeding, loss of consciousness, or possible stroke symptoms.

name: Critical Care Medicine
description: Coordinates intensive monitoring and organ support for critically ill patients.
when_to_consult: Accessed through emergency or hospital teams when a person needs intensive or high-dependency hospital care.

name: Anesthesiology
description: Plans safe anesthesia, monitoring, and perioperative pain support around procedures and surgery.
when_to_consult: Consult before a planned procedure when directed by a surgical or hospital team, especially with health or anesthesia concerns.

name: Family Medicine
description: Provides ongoing, whole-person primary health care for people and families across life stages.
when_to_consult: Consult for routine care, prevention, common health problems, or coordination of longer-term health needs.

name: Public Health and Preventive Medicine
description: Focuses on prevention, screening, population health, occupational health, and health promotion.
when_to_consult: Consult for preventive screening, vaccination planning, workplace health questions, or community-health guidance.

name: Nutrition and Dietetics
description: Provides nutrition assessment and practical food plans that support health conditions and goals.
when_to_consult: Consult for nutrition support, diet planning, weight changes, or a therapeutic diet recommended by a clinician.

name: Physiotherapy
description: Uses movement, exercise, and rehabilitation techniques to support recovery, function, and mobility.
when_to_consult: Consult for pain with movement, recovery after injury or surgery, weakness, balance concerns, or rehabilitation planning.

name: Occupational Therapy
description: Helps people build or regain independence in daily activities, work, school, and home routines.
when_to_consult: Consult for lasting difficulty with self-care, hand use, work tasks, sensory needs, or functional independence.

name: Speech and Language Therapy
description: Assesses and treats communication, speech, language, voice, and swallowing difficulties.
when_to_consult: Consult for speech or language delay, voice changes, stuttering, communication difficulties, or swallowing concerns.

name: Audiology
description: Assesses hearing, balance-related inner-ear concerns, and hearing-device needs.
when_to_consult: Consult for hearing changes, tinnitus, balance symptoms, hearing-aid support, or a child’s hearing assessment.

name: Palliative Medicine
description: Supports comfort, symptom control, communication, and quality of life alongside treatment for serious illness.
when_to_consult: Consult when a serious illness causes burdensome symptoms, complex decisions, or family and caregiver support needs.
